description: This file defines a plugin for sorting Kubernetes resources based on a customizable order, including legacy sorting logic, for use within the kustomize tool.

classes.name: SortOrderTransformerPlugin
classes.description: A plugin that sorts Kubernetes resources based on a specified order, supporting default, FIFO, and legacy sorting options.

classes.name: legacyIDSorter
classes.description: A sorter for resources that orders resources based on predefined priority lists, used for legacy sorting.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures the plugin with provided YAML data.

methods.name: applyDefaults
methods.description: Applies default sorting options if none are specified.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the sorting options for correctness.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Applies the sorting transformation to the resource map.

methods.name: newLegacyIDSorter
methods.description: Creates a legacy ID sorter based on resource list and sorting options.
